chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
I came to know Allah, the Glorified, through the breaking of determinations and the loosening of bonds.
ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali know God according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this profound statement from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) articulates a key epistemological principle in Shia theology: knowing God through the negation of permanence in human affairs. By observing how firm resolutions (azaim) are dissolved and binding contracts (uqud) are released, one recognizes the absolute sovereignty and power of the Creator over transient creation. This reflects the concept of 'tawhid al-af'al' (Oneness of Actions), where divine power is acknowledged through the impermanence of human agency.
